name: alphorn
description: Let AI agents notify you on Slack, Telegram, email, SMS, or push via an Alphorn webhook.
long_description: Gives the agent a send_notification tool. Notifications go to an Alphorn webhook, and Alphorn delivers them to every channel whose filter matches, with retries. Works with the hosted service at app.alphorn.dev and with self-hosted Alphorn.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Endpoint URL
webhook_url.description: The Endpoint URL of your Alphorn webhook, e.g. https://app.alphorn.dev/n/V1StGXR8_Z5jdHi6B-myT

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The webhook's API key (alp_...). Leave empty if the webhook does not require one.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Send a notification to the user through Alphorn
